title: SMOK Nord 5 Replacement Pod 2ml 3 Pack
description: The Smok Nord is back and better than ever! The Nord 5 pod kit improves on just about everything that makes the Nord such an iconic vape kit, with a mighty 80W max power output, improved airflow and smarter chipset. The Nord 5 2ml pod has been newly designed with even more protection in mind. An ingenious lock prevents children from tampering with the device and prevents leaks and spills, while a sealed side port allows for easy refills. The classic Nord wide-bore mouthpiece ensures an extremely comfortable vaping experience. The Nord 5 Pod is compatible with Smoktech’s latest range of RPM 3 mesh coils, which provide incredible flavour and vapour production and pair best with high-VG eliquid.
